profile.headline: Software Developer / DBA at Company Confidential
profile.summary:
I have 10 years of software development experience. My duties have included participating as a member of multiple project teams in project planning, systems analysis and requirements definition, systems design, implementation/development/coding, integration and testing, installation and deployment, documentation, user training, and maintenance of application software. I am fluent in VB.NET, Microsoft SQL (database maintenance and query), Documentum DQL databases/document storage, Microsoft Word and Excel VBA/Object Model, and VBScript. I also have experience in converting applications as needed for software, database, and operating system upgrades. 

My prior positions have been with companies that use multiple technologies and I was often asked to assist with applications that used development tools that I was unfamiliar with. I am able to review existing logic and utilize the unfamiliar environment in a short period of time.

My references include previous employers and professors who will attest to my capacity as a team member.  I can also submit prior performance evaluations to confirm my competence.

positions.title: Software Developer / DBA
positions.description:
Restructured and enhanced existing applications.  Worked with users to add functionality to in-house applications which include time keeping, health and pension call center communications, contributions tracking, accounting reconciliations, and reporting for each area.  Implemented use of exception handling including logging of errors to SQL database.  Replaced duplicate logic with generic classes.  Introduced inline documentation of business rules.

Compiled health and welfare data for quarterly and yearly government related submissions such as the Early Retiree Reinsurance Program (ERRP) and Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP).

Converted and enhanced applications from Microsoft Access to VB.NET/SQL.

Implemented use of version control.

Created documentation for applications and various procedures.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Participated as a member of multiple project teams in requirements definition, implementation/development/coding, integration and testing, and documentation.

Developed majority of applications using VB.NET and SQL databases.

positions.title: Software Developer/Engineer III
positions.description:
Participated as a member of multiple project teams in project planning, systems analysis and requirements definition, systems design, implementation/development/coding, integration and testing, installation and deployment, documentation, and maintenance of application software.

Developed majority of applications using VB.NET, SQL databases, Documentum DQL databases/document storage, Microsoft Word VBA, VBScript, and HTML.

Converted applications for software, database, and operating system upgrades.  Conversions have included VB6 through VB.NET 2008, Microsoft Office 2003 through Microsoft Office 2007, and Microsoft Windows XP through Microsoft Windows 7.  Conversions have also included migration of logic across various programming technologies.

positions.title: Wireless Sales Specialist
positions.description: Achieved 313% of monthly sales quota by the third month of employment, 707% by fourth month; consistently overachieved quota each month.

positions.title: Marketing Researcher
positions.description:
Evaluated published resources and the Internet with the intention of compiling specifics about competitors' products, market scope and share, and financials.

Performed regulatory procedures for registering chemicals with the Cosmetic, Toiletry, and Fragrance Association (CTFA).

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Led a team that varied in size from 7 to 26 members depending on seasonal volumes to consistently achieve net sales goals in excess of one million dollars annually.

Managed and participated in numerous recruitment drives, interviewed and verified the qualifications of prospective employees, engaged in the final decision process for the hiring of employees, responsible for the management and execution of training programs which included the processing of pertinent documentation for all newly hired personnel, performed refresher training as needed for store associates, administered performance evaluations, participated in promotion decisions including those for upper store management, and conducted other management functions as needed for store operations.

Coordinated and oversaw multiple inventories; consistently achieved company standard of less than 1.0% level of shrink.

Traveled to store locations within and outside of district to assist during training of new management, also to support staff while management team members vacationed.

Scouted various shopping malls to ascertain the likelihood of success regarding potential new store openings; surveyed existing mall clientele to establish if essential numbers of target clientele were present, assessed traffic volume, and determined if placement of available site within shopping mall was advantageous to maximizing sales.

Contributed in the opening of a new location and in the relocation of an undersized store to a larger renovated space.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Psychology with a concentration in Biology Education
